title: Interactive E-Commerce Storefront
description: Full-featured shopping platform with interactive product filtering, shopping cart drawer, and order checkout flow.
fullDescription: A modern, highly responsive e-commerce application designed to deliver seamless shopping experiences. Features include real-time client-side search, multi-category filtering, persistent shopping cart state, price calculations, and item counter management.
features: Dynamic product search with instant debounced filtering
Slide-out slide-over cart drawer with persistent state
Responsive multi-column product layout with smooth animation
Subtotal, shipping, and tax calculation breakdown
challengesFaced: Managing state synchronized between search query parameters and complex nested cart operations while maintaining 60fps animations.
learningOutcomes: Mastered React state management patterns, custom hooks for local storage persistence, and Tailwind CSS grid layouts.

title: Real-time Task & Habit Tracker
description: Productivity dashboard featuring customizable daily habit streaks, task prioritization, and weekly progress charts.
fullDescription: A sleek task and habit tracking portal empowering users to organize daily workflows, measure consistency with streak counters, and view progress statistics through clean visual metrics.
features: Streak counter visualization with completion badges
Category tags and priority color indicators
Daily progress bar and historical archive
Light and dark mode theme compatibility
challengesFaced: Optimizing date comparison logic for streak calculations across different timezone offsets.
learningOutcomes: Deepened understanding of date manipulation, complex conditional rendering, and key-value state synchronization.

title: Retro Arcade Space Shooter
description: Canvas-based 2D retro space shooter game with enemy waves, score leaderboards, sound effects, and power-ups.
fullDescription: An energetic HTML5 Canvas retro arcade game built with pure JavaScript logic. Players control a starship fighting off incoming asteroid belts and alien bosses while collecting weapon upgrades and extra shields.
features: Smooth 60 FPS requestAnimationFrame rendering cycle
Collision detection algorithm for projectiles and targets
Interactive high score save system via LocalStorage
Retro particle explosion particle system
challengesFaced: Handling multiple frame collision checks efficiently without causing frame drops or stutter on mobile devices.
learningOutcomes: Gained hands-on expertise with HTML5 Canvas 2D context, velocity vectors, and object-oriented game loops.

title: Developer Portfolio Showcase
description: Personal developer portfolio featuring project galleries, interactive skill sliders, contact form, and theme switch.
fullDescription: A modern personal portfolio template tailored for software engineers. Incorporates responsive visual cards, smooth scroll navigation, dark theme support, and interactive resume modals.
features: Fluid page transitions powered by Framer Motion
Interactive technical skill progress indicators
Contact form validation with modal response toast
Accessible typography and semantic HTML5 layout
challengesFaced: Designing an ultra-clean visual layout that highlights technical skills while maintaining fast page load times.
learningOutcomes: Refined core UX design principles, micro-interactions, and responsive layout composition.

title: Global Weather Analytics Portal
description: Live weather forecast dashboard providing multi-day climate metrics, humidity gauges, and geolocation lookup.
fullDescription: A responsive weather intelligence web app fetching real-time data from weather REST APIs. Provides 7-day extended forecasts, hourly temperature curves, UV indices, and wind velocity meters.
features: Auto-detect user coordinates via browser Geolocation API
City search with debounced autocomplete suggestions
Dynamic weather condition visual indicators and background themes
7-day detailed meteorological forecast grid
challengesFaced: Gracefully handling API error boundaries, rate limits, and missing location permission fallback states.
learningOutcomes: Mastered asynchronous data fetching with fetch/async-await, loading skeletons, and REST API consumption.

title: Firebase Social Media Mini Board
description: Real-time community feed where users post updates, like posts, and filter threads by tags.
fullDescription: An interactive web bulletin board leveraging Firebase Firestore for real-time document sync. Users can author short posts, attach code snippets, upvote posts, and filter content by hashtag.
features: Instant real-time Firestore database listener updates
Tag-based filtering system (e.g., #React, #WebDev)
Optimistic UI updates for likes and bookmarking
Clean timeline card layout with timestamp formatting
challengesFaced: Structuring Firestore security rules and index definitions for compound query filtering.
learningOutcomes: Learned cloud database synchronization, real-time listeners, and optimistic UI updates.

title: Markdown Documentation Studio
description: Side-by-side Markdown editor with live HTML preview, table generator, export to PDF, and syntax highlighting.
fullDescription: A developer tool designed for authoring technical documentation. Features instant side-by-side rendering, custom syntax themes, character/word counters, and one-click copy/download options.
features: Real-time dual pane live Markdown parser
Export markdown files directly as .md or formatted HTML
Code block syntax highlight previewer
Document word and character stat metrics
challengesFaced: Sanitizing user-generated markdown content against XSS script injection vulnerabilities.
learningOutcomes: Strengthened DOM string parsing techniques, web safety practices, and file download APIs.

title: Crypto Currency Price Tracker
description: Financial market overview displaying live token prices, market caps, 24h change percentages, and search filter.
fullDescription: A clean financial dashboard tracking top cryptocurrencies using public market REST APIs. Users can inspect live exchange rates, filter coins by search or market cap tier, and bookmark favorites.
features: Top 100 coin market listings with real-time price updates
Green/Red color indicators for positive and negative 24h trends
Interactive watchlist favorite toggle saved in local storage
Responsive data table with numerical sorting
challengesFaced: Formatting large numerical values accurately into currency and standard abbreviations (e.g. $1.2B).
learningOutcomes: Enhanced proficiency with Intl.NumberFormat APIs, polling timers, and state array sorting.

title: Interactive Memory Match Card Game
description: Fun brain-training card flipping game with timers, move counters, difficulty modes, and sound effects.
fullDescription: A playful memory card game designed with smooth 3D flip card animations. Users flip cards to match pairs against a countdown timer and move tally.
features: CSS 3D transform card flip effects
Timer tick counter and move calculation
Game victory modal with score rating calculation
Reset and card shuffle algorithms
challengesFaced: Preventing accidental extra card clicks during rapid multi-click flip animations.
learningOutcomes: Gained mastery over JavaScript event handling, lock flags, and CSS 3D perspectives.

title: Full-Stack Recipe Finder App
description: Culinary discovery app allowing users to search recipes by ingredients, dietary filters, and meal type.
fullDescription: An intuitive cooking assistant app designed for home chefs. Search thousands of recipes based on available kitchen ingredients, filter by vegetarian/gluten-free, and view step-by-step cooking instructions.
features: Multi-ingredient search query builder
Detailed nutrition summary and ingredient checklists
Bookmark favorite recipes for quick reference
Printable step-by-step preparation guide
challengesFaced: Handling multi-criteria array filtering for dietary preferences simultaneously.
learningOutcomes: Improved multi-filter state logic and structured modal display layouts.
